decisions.decision: Maintain only one root RELEASE.md per source repository; overwrite that file on each release.

Keep .memory JSON decisions in Git source repositories only. Never distribute the .memory directory inside extension VSIX, extension source ZIP, Library source ZIP, public release assets or build artifacts. Verify each archive before publication.

Run memory-sensitive tests on the extracted release archive with .memory excluded. Tests may validate the full source memory only when it exists in the Git checkout, and must also pass in standalone distribution ZIPs.

Every accepted source update requires its own next sequential ATGV version, reviewed branch and pull request; automatically squash-merge eligible PRs only after the complete required CI suite succeeds, GitHub branch protections permit merge, and the exact PR head SHA is verified. Never bypass failures or fabricate a release. On main-branch success publish the verified VSIX, checksum and source archive, with exactly one RELEASE.md.
